Menu and Options Reworked:

-Options aesthetics redesigned.
-AZERTY and QWERTY keyboard buttons added for quicker switching.
-Depending on the chosen language, keys will be automatically assigned to QWERTY or AZERTY.
-The option to choose your own personal keys is still available.
-The Reset button will reset to the keyboard layout you have defined (QWERTY or AZERTY).
